howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through using Plaso tools to extract events from a disk image, generate a super timeline, and import it into Timesketch for analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to investigate a computer intrusion and reconstruct a full timeline of file access, registry, logs, and other activities.
